races.name: Human
races.lore_ru: Люди Штормграда — стойкие защитники Азерота, славящиеся дипломатией, непоколебимым духом и верностью идеалам Света.
races.lore_en: Humans of Stormwind are noble defenders of Azeroth, renowned for diplomacy, indomitable spirit, and devotion to the Light.
races.lore_fi: Myrskytuulen ihmiset ovat Azerothin jaloja puolustajia, tunnettuja diplomatiasta, periksiantamattomuudesta ja Valon palvonnasta.
races.racial_ability_desc: Removes all movement impairing effects and loss of control.

races.name: Dwarf
races.lore_ru: Дворфы Стальгорна — отважные исследователи горных недр Каз Модана, непревзойденные кузнецы и верные союзники.
races.lore_en: Dwarves of Ironforge are courageous miners and blacksmiths of Khaz Modan with an insatiable thirst for ancient titan lore.
races.lore_fi: Rautatakomon kääpiöt ovat Khaz Modanin rohkeita kaivajia ja seppiä, jotka tutkivat titaanien muinaisia salaisuuksia.
races.racial_ability_desc: Increases armor and grants immunity to bleed, poison, and disease.

races.name: Night Elf
races.lore_ru: Ночные эльфы — древний народ Калимдора, хранители мирового древа Тельдрассил и служители богини луны Элуны.
races.lore_en: Night Elves are ancient reclusive guardians of nature, guided by the moon goddess Elune and the spirits of Teldrassil.
races.lore_fi: Yöhaltiat ovat luonnon ikivanhoja vartijoita, joita ohjaavat kuunjumalatar Elune ja Teldrassilin henget.
races.racial_ability_desc: Slip into the shadows, reducing the chance enemies will detect your presence.

races.name: Gnome
races.lore_ru: Гномы — эксцентричные гении технологии и инженерной мысли, не знающие преград в решении сложнейших загадок механизма.
races.lore_en: Gnomes are diminutive, brilliantly eccentric inventors who combine boundless curiosity with radical technological genius.
races.lore_fi: Gnoomit ovat pienikokoisia ja nerokkaita keksijöitä, joiden kekseliäisyys ylittää kaikki esteet.
races.racial_ability_desc: +5% to primary class resource (mana, energy, or rage).

races.name: Skyborne
races.lore_ru: Скайборны — крылатые хранители парящих вершин Zephras Isle. В Альянсе они почитают дисциплину High Order, в Орде — свободу ветра Windshaper.
races.lore_en: Skyborne are winged wanderers from Zephras Isle. In the Alliance they align with High Order discipline; in the Horde they embrace Windshaper freedom.
races.lore_fi: Skybornet ovat siivekkäitä vaeltajia Zephras-saarelta. Liittoumassa he seuraavat Korkeaa Järjestystä, Laumassa Tuulimuovaajien vapautta.
races.racial_ability_desc: Actively glide for 10 seconds with full directional control. 2-minute cooldown.

races.name: Orc
races.lore_ru: Орки Дуротара — закаленные воины чести и выживания, возглавляющие Новую Орду Тралла в согласии со стихиями.
races.lore_en: Orcs of Durotar are fierce yet honorable survivors who built a new home under the banner of Thrall's shamanic Horde.
races.lore_fi: Durotarin örkit ovat sotureita, jotka löysivät uuden kodin ja kunnian Thrallin uuden Lauman alaisuudessa.
races.racial_ability_desc: +1% critical strike chance to all attacks and spells while wielding an axe.

races.name: Undead
races.lore_ru: Отрекшиеся — освободившиеся от власти Плети мертвецы Подгорода, сражающиеся за свое право на существование под знаменем Сильваны.
races.lore_en: The Forsaken are free-willed undead of the Undercity who fight relentlessly to carve their sovereign place in a hostile world.
races.lore_fi: Hyljätyt ovat vapautuneita epäkuolleita, jotka taistelevat olemassaolostaan vihamielisessä maailmassa.
races.racial_ability_desc: Removes any Charm, Fear, and Sleep effects.

races.name: Tauren
races.lore_ru: Таурены — миролюбивые великаны Мулгора, преданные почитатели Матери-Земли и хранители священных традиций природы.
races.lore_en: Tauren are noble giant nomads of Mulgore, revering the Earth Mother and walking in harmony with nature's spiritual rhythm.
races.lore_fi: Taureenit ovat Mulgoren jaloja jättiläisiä, jotka kunnioittavat Maa-äitiä ja elävät luonnon tasapainossa.
races.racial_ability_desc: Stuns up to 5 nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

races.name: Troll
races.lore_ru: Тролли Черного Копья — мудрые охотники и почитатели Лоа, принесшие нерушимую клятву верности Орде под предводительством Вол'джина.
races.lore_en: Darkspear Trolls are cunning jungle hunters and Loa worshippers, loyal blood brothers of the Horde led by Vol'jin.
races.lore_fi: Darkspear-peikot ovat viidakon ovelia metsästäjiä, jotka palvovat Loa-henkiä ja seisovat Lauman rinnalla.
races.racial_ability_desc: Increases attack and casting speed by 10% to 30% depending on health.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Visit class trainer at Northshire Abbey at levels 2 and 4.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Purchase your first 6-slot bag as soon as you have 5 silver.
starter_zones.next_zone_direction: Head south through the gates towards Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Train your rank 1 skills at Anvilmar trainers at level 2.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Buy an additional pouch from Anvilmar general goods vendor.
starter_zones.next_zone_direction: Exit east through the pass to Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Visit Aldrassil sanctuary trainers at levels 2 and 4.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Clear spiders and buy bags at Aldrassil before leaving.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Train skills in the Den at levels 2 and 4.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Save copper from boars for first bag vendor outside the Den.
starter_zones.next_zone_direction: Head north-east to Sen'jin Village and Razor Hill.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Return to the crypt chapel for skill upgrades at level 2 and 4.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Sell scavenger junk to buy initial 6-slot bag.
starter_zones.next_zone_direction: Follow the western road to Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Visit the central tent trainers at levels 2 and 4.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Check the trade goods vendor for starter satchels.
starter_zones.next_zone_direction: Head north past the totem gate to Bloodhoof Village.

starter_zones.trainer_reminder: Ascend the Aerie Spire to unlock wind-infused spells.
starter_zones.bag_reminder: Gather cloud feathers to barter for a breezy feather-pack.
starter_zones.next_zone_direction: Take the wind-skiff to either Stormwind Harbor or Bladefist Bay.
